data.explanation: This is a normal invoice for electrical work done in your home on 17 March 2026. Pay the total of €1,214.99 to the IBAN printed on the invoice, without deductions, within 14 days of the invoice date (the app shows the exact due date). Use the invoice number as the payment reference. Check that the work and hours match what was done. Part of the labour cost may be deductible as a craftsman's service (Handwerkerleistung) in your tax return if you pay by bank transfer and keep the invoice.
